abstract: Antibody affinity maturation relies on somatic hypermutation and affinity-based selection of B cell clones. A new study shows that phased variability in B cell fate decisions, often encoded by non-genetic cellular states, enhances this evolutionary process by permitting the emergence and persistence of rare outlier cells with advantageous properties.

title: Phased variability in cell fate determination orchestrates antibody evolution.
